feature: An icon frame's white stays out of its SVG
summary: An icon drawn in an icon frame now leaves with nothing behind it, from Export and from Copy, so it sits on a dark page or a coloured one. A colour you gave the frame stays, and a screen exports as it always did.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Walk: icon-frame-white-stays-out-walk.

try.do: Open New Frame, pick 24 under Icons, and press Add Frame.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Draw a circle in the frame with the Ellipse tool.
Open Export, pick SVG, and read the Include the background row: unticked, with a white swatch.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Save the file and open it in a browser on a dark page. In the picture, Before is the same circle written with the background kept.
Pick the frame, press Command C, and paste into an app that reads SVG.
Give the frame a colour, open Export again, and read the row: ticked, with that colour in the swatch.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Add a Phone frame, open Export on it, and check there is no row and the white is in the file.

evaluate: Does the icon sit cleanly on your dark page with no box round it?
Is a coloured frame opening ticked what you expect, given a plain one opens unticked?
Should a screen frame stay without the row, or would you want to leave its surface out too?
A square frame of 512 or less counts as an icon by the app's own rule. Is losing its white right for a hand drawn 300 by 300 frame?
rough: No mock covers this surface: the Export sheet's background row is not on a mock page.
White picked by hand reads the same as white left alone, because a frame only stores its colour. It leaves the file unless you tick the box, and Copy has no box to tick.

A moving shape close to the edge can keep the frame's clip in the file. The sample bell does: its box corner reaches 24.48 at full swing, though its ink stops inside 24. The clip paints nothing, and there is no white behind the bell.

The checkbox was pressed by name in the walk, not clicked at a point, because a walk cannot click inside a sheet. The save panel is not driven either: the file comes from the same writer the sheet calls.
The Export sheet offers no row on a whole drawing that has no flat canvas under it, so an icon frame's white stays in that one case.
